_readme: Hand-picked newsletter queue. Add one object per item you want considered for the Friday digest. The digest picks the newest items that fit, ranked so releases lead. Nothing here is auto-picked from the dev log, Instagram, or the board. Field guide: date = when the item became public (YYYY-MM-DD or 'D Month YYYY'); kind = book | game | workshop | tool | app | studio | fix; title = headline as a learner or parent would read it; blurb = one or two warm sentences, no ticket text, no file paths, no 'Evidence:'; link = public URL (devlog anchor, page, or store link), optional; image = public image path, optional; pinned = true forces it into the next digest regardless of age.

items.title: CORRUPTED: a Roblox workshop where the level destroys itself
items.blurb: The ninth Roblox build asks a new question: will the level still be there when you reach it? Platforms vanish as you leave them and a neon wall closes in behind you. Starts from an empty scene and ends with a course you can share.

items.title: Who Goes There? Build a 3D co-op game in Godot
items.blurb: A two-part Godot 4 project for ages 8 and up, built with a grown-up. Scan visitors, manage the gate and survive ten days, from an empty 3D scene to a game you can play together.

items.title: A clearer welcome to the studio
items.blurb: The front door got a rewrite. It is now easier to see what you can make here and how to start, in the first few seconds.

items.title: Safer offline updates
items.blurb: Pages now update cleanly when you come back online, without getting stuck on an old copy. Handy on school networks and patchy wifi.

items.title: Correct answers, smoother workshop progress
items.blurb: Quiz answers and workshop progress line up properly now, so finishing a step feels like finishing it.
